answer.says: Shri Hegde, you will find the second bedroom has a window facing the compound. The morning light there is better than in the east room. As for the matter of the file, I trust the Directorate will sort the error between Hegde and Hegel without further trouble; it is a matter of letters, not of substance. I shall be on the step with the papers. Do not disturb me unless the house is on fire.
answer.thought: The cohabitation of Hegel and Hegde is a living contradiction: the name is the same, the substance entirely different. I must settle the matter of the room allocation before I leave; it is a question of the particular fitting the universal form of the household. Ramesh’s towel is a small act of care, a particular serving the universal comfort of my feet.
